questions.Description: Use Tinker cad's circuit simulation tool to model a smart street lighting system. Simulate light sensors triggering LEDs to turn on/off.
Create a simulation of a smart waste management system using Scratch. Design sprites representing bins and program logic to indicate when bins are full.
Monitor real-time temperature readings remotely through the IoT                  cloud platform(e.g., Cayenne, Blynk) integration on Tinker cad
Measure temperature using a sensor(DHT11) and visualize the data online using Arduino IDE and Thing speak
Set up a temperature and humidity monitoring system using ESP8266 and DHT11 sensor. Use Things Board to visualize sensor data in real-time and gain insights into IoT device management.
Develop a system to track public transportation vehicles using a GPS module connected to an Arduino. Display the vehicle's location on an LCD screen or serial monitor.
Create a simple web server on the Node MCU using  Arduino IDE and control   the LED remotely by accessing the web server through a browser
Create a simple publisher/subscriber setup where you can control the LED's state via MQTT messages
Program the Noden MCUs to read student RFID tags and publish attendance data via MQTT.
Connect the Node MCU to IFTTT and program it to control the lights based on voice commands received from Google Assistant.
Simulate emergency scenarios (e.g., fire alarm) using buttons or sensors. Alert and activate audible alarms to notify users of the emergency using MQTT for communication in a smart city environment
